v1.6.4b (2 April 2023) |feed_title = Version 1.6.4 |previous_update = [[v1.6.3]] |next_update = [[v1.7.0]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.6.4''' is the fiftieth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 31st of March 2023. It rebalanced multiple towers and updated or added four maps. This version encompassed three updates, the main v1.6.4 update (released 31 March 2023) and two minor updates, the v1.6.4a (released 1 April 2023) and v1.6.4b (released 2 April 2023). ==Additions==
